## Summary

Please include a short summary of the changes made and why this PR should be merged from `develop` -> `master`.

If this PR fixes a bug or closes an issue, include the issue number (e.g., `Fixes #123`).

---

## Type of change
Choose one or more: Bug fix, New feature, Refactor, Documentation, Chore, CI

---

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's style and conventions
- [ ] I added tests for my changes where applicable
- [ ] All tests pass locally
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation (README, comments) if needed
- [ ] I updated the changelog or release notes if this change affects the public API

---

## Files changed / Key points
List the files and the important pieces of work in this PR (short bullets). This makes reviews faster.

---

## Testing
Describe how you validated the change locally and in CI. Include commands to run if reviewers want to reproduce.

Example:
```
npm install
npm run build
npm run test
```

---

## Deployment notes
Anything reviewers or release engineers should be aware of when deploying (migrations, env updates, downtime, etc.)

---

## Backwards compatibility / Breaking change
Explain whether this change is backwards-compatible or if it introduces breaking changes.

---

## Additional context
Add any other context here — screenshots, design notes, links to RFCs / tickets.
